parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: The container is a stainless steel bowl-like part used to hold ingredients or liquids during operation.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main vessel for mixing or holding coffee or other ingredients, ensuring stability and hygiene.
parts.Movement_description: It can be detached and reattached for cleaning or refilling but remains stationary during operation.

parts.name: Knob
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic knob located on the front of the machine, used for user control.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to adjust settings such as speed or power.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or clicks into different positions to change machine settings.

parts.name: Knob
parts.Basic_description: Another control knob made of plastic, similar in design to the first knob.
parts.Functional_description: It may control a secondary function such as temperature or timer.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or presses to adjust machine parameters.

parts.name: Rotation
parts.Basic_description: The rotation part is the mixing or stirring attachment made of aluminum.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates to mix or stir the contents inside the container.
parts.Movement_description: It spins around its axis when the machine is powered on, driven by an internal motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main structural frame of the coffeemachine, made of aluminum alloy.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other components, houses the motor, and provides stability during operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a rigid foundation for the entire machine.
